reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the CNV detection use-case batch for use-case-cnv-detection-characterisation: 598 records (488 results, 42 evaluations, 28 configurations, 15 methods, 8 protocols, 7 sources, 6 datasets, 3 claims, 1 benchmark). All seven new source artifacts and the reused amp-source-dragen-supplementary-tables XLSX were re-downloaded and matched their recorded SHA-256; the archived artifacts/*.gz decompress to the same bytes. All 488 results were re-read from the pinned cells with a separate parser (the extractor's scripts were not run) and match in value, printed form, metric, qualifier, unit, direction, configuration, protocol and scoring counts. 59 descriptive fields were corrected without changing any number; they are listed in docs/reviews/use-cases/cnv-detection-characterisation-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any caller.
Figures were not checked, so prose-versus-figure questions in De La Vega Results 3.1 are unresolved.
SEQC2 Additional file 1 and the DRAGEN article text (amp-source-dragen) were not re-read.
Europe PMC outer supplementaryFiles zips are rebuilt per request, so their recorded container hashes cannot be re-verified; the inner files and inner publisher zips were verified.
Store-form files (batch.store.jsonl, store-form.md, extract/registry_fit.py) were reviewed later than the rest; see store_form_review.
